description: Metadata describing one stored document in the library. Carries everything the open dialog needs to list and preview an item without loading its full payload — the payload is fetched lazily through the kind-specific document provider when the user opens it.

members.name: Author
members.description: Optional display name of the last author. Null when unknown.

members.name: FolderPath
members.description: Virtual folder path the document lives in (e.g. "/Designs/Mobile"). Null for flat stores that do not organise documents into folders.

members.name: ModifiedAt
members.description: UTC timestamp of the last modification. Used both for sorting and as the optimistic-concurrency token surfaced to MCP write tools.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable document name shown in the listing.

members.name: PreviewSvg
members.description: Optional cached SVG thumbnail rendered from the document, shown in grid view. Null when the store does not provide previews.
